about: Massachusetts's inner borders, town by town: scripts/ma-shapes.mjs reads this, gives every town to a shetach and writes data/shapes/ma-*.geojson (which data/shetachim.json claims), along the real town lines (owner, Nov 3: "Look at the North Shore. That's like a proper, nice European border type" — not smoothed curves, "so ugly and unsettling"), except where a town line made a spike or a zigzag: there a straight line between two town corners cuts across (`cuts`; owner: "Straight can also work sometimes ... a hybrid of straight and not straight"). Change a town here, then run `node scripts/ma-shapes.mjs` and `npm run build`. Towns not listed go by their middle's longitude: west of `deren` is Connecticut's shetach (its own band claim, kept exact), between `deren` and `split` Central Massachusetts, east of `split` Eastern Massachusetts. A cut's towns are split along its line: left of it (drawn from its first point to its second) to `left`, the rest to `right`. Cape Cod and the Islands keep their three counties exactly. `patches`, applied last: a polygon whose land goes from `from` to `to`, for a straight line that shouldn't cross a whole town (its other edges run through land already on its side). `exact`: shetachim that keep their own town (and tract) claims in shetachim.json (the North Shore); the shapes are cut to them.

cuts.why: Prus–Fogelman: Wellesley's corner poked east and Dover west, a zigzag; one nearly vertical line instead, from the Weston/Wellesley/Newton corner down to Medfield's corner on Dover (owner, Nov 3: "there are many sections that it can just be a vertical line"). Wellesley Weston Chabad House stays Fogelman's, Needham's Chabad Prus's.

Prus–Fogelman: Sharon and Foxborough's line made a double spike; a straight line from the Walpole/Foxborough/Sharon corner to the Sharon/Mansfield/Easton corner. Sharon's two houses stay Prus's, Mansfield's Fogelman's.

Merrimack Valley–Prus: Billerica's corner poked up into Chelmsford and Tewksbury and Tewksbury's tip down between Billerica and Wilmington, a Λ and a V (owner, Nov 3, phone screenshot: "YOU DID NOT DO THE POINTY SHIT AGAIN"; "just make your own custom line"); one straight line from the Carlisle/Chelmsford/Billerica corner to the Tewksbury/Wilmington/Andover corner, where the Wilmington cut carries on.
Merrimack Valley–Prus: Wilmington's thin prong up into Andover; a straight line across its base, from the Tewksbury/Wilmington/Andover corner to the Andover/North Reading/Wilmington corner.

patches.why: South Area (Gurkow): Canton's corner cut a deep notch between Randolph and Stoughton, with Randolph's thin tip above it (owner, Nov 4: "so nasty and pointy in so many places"). One straight north–south line at 71.0956°W instead, from Randolph's north line down to the Canton/Stoughton corner: Canton's side of it east of the line (Ponkapoag, the Blue Hills) to the South Area. Chabad of Canton stays Prus's.
South Area: Randolph's tip west of that line, to Prus (Canton).

South Area: Stoughton's staircase on Canton and Sharon, a few hundred metres north of Shaloh House; one straight line from the Stoughton/Canton line to the Stoughton/Canton/Sharon corner. Stoughton north of it to Prus …
… and Canton's slivers south of it to the South Area. Shaloh House stays 300 m inside.
South Area: Easton's sharp south-east tip (a 68° point); a straight line across it, from the Easton/Raynham line 2 km from the tip to Easton's West Bridgewater line, the tip to Prus.

South Area: Brockton's south line stepped (a tooth down into West Bridgewater); one straight line from the Easton/Brockton/West Bridgewater corner to Brockton's south-east corner. West Bridgewater's side north of it to the South Area …
… and Brockton's tooth south of it to Prus (about the same area each way).
South Area: Abington's square notch into the South Area between Brockton and Holbrook; a straight line across its mouth, the notch to the South Area.

South Area: Braintree's west line stepped where it met Randolph's north line; one straight line carrying Braintree's diagonal on to Randolph's line (the corner between, Blue Hills woods in Quincy, to the South Area).
